blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Saturday denied knowing the alleged former security officer of former Speaker Lord Allan Velasco who supposedly delivered money to her and other members of her family. Duterte made the pronouncement after the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) recently revealed that it is investigating claims by dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., that he delivered suitcases of cash to the vice president, former President Rodrigo Duterte, as well as Davao City 1st District Rep. Paolo Duterte on Velasco’s instructions. “I do not know Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., nor have I ever received any money from him,” […]...
